create_FocalLoss: create a FocalLoss module with configurable gamma and num_classes for imbalanced classification
build_FastRCNNFocalLoss: build a FastRCNNFocalLoss instance from class logits, proposal deltas, and ground truth proposals
run_FastRCNNFocalLoss_losses: run the losses method on FastRCNNFocalLoss to compute classification and box regression losses
build_FastRCNNFocalLossOutputLayers: build a FastRCNNFocalLossOutputLayers head with config and input shape for focal loss training
run_FocalLoss_forward: run FocalLoss forward pass with predicted logits and target class indices to get focal loss value
